title: 第25章 姐弟同心凄厉不断第26章 另类丹药小白鼠
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 陈初阳越发欣赏这个小胖子，年纪轻轻，信守承诺，是个好苗子。
既然如此，他怎么也要帮一把。
再怎么说，也是自己的前任小舅子，不能见死不救。
那么。
有请小舅子上锅。
“商跃，请。”
“干嘛？”
商跃怒目凝视，想要推开陈初阳的手。
陈初阳岂是他能够推开的，反手，握住他的手，直接镇压住他的身躯，血气无法动弹，没有凝聚气种的商跃，没有真气，如果他有真气，他会惊讶发现，自己的真气也被镇压了，混元真气面前，任何真气都会被镇压。
这就是陈初阳的混元真气的霸道之处，胆敢不听话，直接吞了。
“你说呢，请你上锅。”
陈初阳笑嘻嘻道：“你是自己上去呢，还是我送你上去。”
商跃用力，无法挣脱，再用力，还是如此，他赫然发现，自己竟然不是陈初阳的对手，力量上还是各方面，都被镇压了，他想到了父亲，那一天，他以为父亲放水了，任由陈初阳摆弄，不曾想，原来不是……这样。
父亲，也是被镇压了，任由他摆布。
“放手。”
商跃努力做出凶残的样子，企图震慑陈初阳，让他放手。
陈初阳可不会被吓到，提着他的脖子，直接丢进去锅里面。
“陈初阳，我警告你，不要乱来，我可是商家的……”
“聒噪。”
陈初阳用力一按，商跃的整个脑袋朝着锅里面的绿色的液体埋进去，呼吸困难，整个人都无法呼吸，满嘴都是那股恶臭的味道。
商红雪见状，连忙规劝：“初阳哥哥，商跃他不是故意的，你就饶了他吧。”
陈初阳这才松开手，商跃的头这才伸出来透气。
“呼呼。”
“陈初阳，我和你拼了。”
一巴掌过去，商跃听话了。
老老实实坐在锅里面，不敢吭声，也不敢说话。
乖巧得像是小鸡仔一样。
委屈巴巴的样子，像极了深闺怨妇。
陈初阳拍拍手，扫了他一眼，很满意现在的小胖子。
“商跃，记得了，不要乱动，也不要乱来，我可不是你大姐，也不是你父亲。”
content_en:
Chen Chuyang admired this little fat man more and more. He was young, kept his promises, and was a good young man.
In this case, he had to help no matter what.
After all, he was still his ex-brother-in-law, and he couldn't just die without saving him.
So.
I invited my brother-in-law to serve.
"Shang Yue, please."
"What for?"
Shang Yue stared angrily, trying to push Chen Chuyang's hand away.
How could he push Chen Chuyang away? He turned around, held his hand, and directly suppressed his body. His blood energy could not move. Shang Yue, who had not condensed his energy, had no true energy. If he had true energy, he would be surprised to find that his own true energy had also been suppressed. In front of the Hunyuan true energy, any true energy would be suppressed.
This is the domineering nature of Chen Chuyang's Hunyuan Qi. If he dares to disobey, he will swallow it directly.
"What do you mean, please come to the pot."
Chen Chuyang said with a smile: "Should you go up by yourself, or should I send you up?"
Shang Yue tried hard, but couldn't break free. No matter how hard he tried, it was still the same. He suddenly realized that he was no match for Chen Chuyang. In terms of strength, he was suppressed in every aspect. He thought of his father. That day, he thought his father had given up and allowed Chen Chuyang to manipulate him. He never thought that it turned out to be not... like this.
My father was also suppressed and left to his mercy.
"Let go."
Shang Yue tried his best to look ferocious, trying to scare Chen Chuyang into letting him go.
Chen Chuyang would not be frightened, so he picked up his neck and threw him directly into the pot.
"Chen Chuyang, I'm warning you, don't act recklessly, I'm a merchant..."
"Noisy."
Chen Chuyang pressed hard, and Shang Yue's whole head was buried into the green liquid in the pot. It was difficult to breathe, and he couldn't breathe. His mouth was filled with the stench.
Seeing this, Shang Hongxue quickly advised: "Brother Chuyang, Shang Yue didn't do it on purpose, just spare him."
Only then did Chen Chuyang let go of his hand, and then Shang Yue's head stretched out for air.
"Huhu."
"Chen Chuyang, I will fight with you."
"Crack."
After a slap, Shang Yue obeyed.
Sitting in the pot honestly, not daring to say anything or speak.
As cute as a little chicken.
Her aggrieved look was like that of a harried woman.
Chen Chuyang clapped his hands and glanced at him, feeling very satisfied with the little fat man now.
"Shang Yue, remember, don't move or mess around. I'm not your eldest sister, nor your father."
